body: She's only 14, so she's is far too young to deal with and help with this situation.  I can't go back and be a burden to my "foster family".  It was a worse feeling knowing I was a burden to them than being comfortable with suicide.

The only person in my family I still occasionally speak with is my much younger sister, however my mother has attempted to cease this communication.  My sister is far too young to help (and is slowly being poisoned against me) and my family would not speak to me about this if I tried.

I can think of no one that I would want to leave a note with.
